question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Apart
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Apart"** means separated by a distance; not together. (अलग)

 
 
• **Example: **The two houses are situated miles** apart** from each other.
 
 
 
• **"Nearby" **refers to something that is close at hand or within a short distance. (निकट)
 
 
• **Example: **There is a grocery store **nearby** our house.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'apart' **is **'nearby'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Contaminated **(प्रदूषित): Made impure by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance.

 
 
• **Example:** The water in the river is **contaminated** with industrial waste.
 
 
 
• **Contagious **(संक्रामक): Capable of being transmitted from one individual to another.
 
 
• **Example: **The flu is highly **contagious **and can spread rapidly among people.
 
 
 
• **Huge** (विशाल): Extremely large in size or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The company made a** huge** profit last year.
